tool_definitions.name: job
tool_definitions.description: run a shell command in the background. For a server, bind a fixed port and pass it as `port`; the tool forwards that same number, reports the URL the user opens it at, and does not discover an ephemeral port. You are told when it ends, and woken if you have ended your turn, so end your turn rather than waiting or polling for it.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: the job name; for start, use one short role such as 'check', not a specific compound such as 'cachecheck'—a live duplicate is automatically numbered, such as 'check-1'; 1–10 characters from [a-z0-9-] (for all actions except 'list', 'prune')

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: an optional TCP port inside the sandbox to forward to the user (for start)

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: the command line (for action 'start'); if omitted, re-runs previous job by name

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: for action 'start', what you are doing, as a 5 to 7 word phrase opening with a capitalised -ing verb, such as "Regenerating every golden in the scratch copy"

parameters.name: respawn
parameters.description: for action 'start', start the command again each time it exits, still notifying you; stop the job to end it. Respawning gives up after 3 runs in a row each end within 2s

event.text: Use one short role such as `check`; a simultaneous duplicate is automatically named `check-1`.

payload.content: Use one short role such as `check`; a simultaneous duplicate is automatically named `check-1`.
